ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَ سَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ سَيِّدِ الْأَكْوَانِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Sayyidi ‘l-akwān.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, the chief of all existence!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ صَلَاةً تَمْلَأُ الْأَمْكِنَةَ وَ الْأَزْمَانَ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ṣalātan tamla’u ‘l-amkinata wa ‘l-azmān.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family a prayer filling all places and times!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ صَلَاةً نَرْتَقِيْ بِهَا إِلَى مَقَامِ الْمَعْرِفَةِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ṣalātan nartaqī bi hā ilā maqāmi ‘l-ma`rifati wa ‘l-ihsān.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, a prayer raising us to the rank of realization and perfection!
